verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Marqeta is a hosted payments platform that holds customer data. The only evidence of getting data out is indirect: Core API endpoints that retrieve transactions by card, merchant and account holder, user, business and card-product resources, webhooks that push events to your own endpoint, and an MCP server that queries Core API data. Nothing shows a bulk export or portability feature. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-data export, explicit open export formats, migration/offboarding guidance, and any independent corroboration.
